title: How is Joseph Stalin connected to Elmo?
description:
Four real photos connect Joseph Stalin to Elmo from Sesame Street, through Churchill, the Queen and a first lady.

Joseph Stalin → Winston Churchill → Elizabeth II → Laura Bush → Elmo

Give me two names in the comments and I'll find the photos that connect them.

Photo credits:
Photo 1, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Yalta_summit_1945_with_Churchill,_Roosevelt,_Stalin.jpg
Photo 2 by Official photographer, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Churchill_queen_Elizabeth_1953.jpg
Photo 3 by White House photo by Shealah Craighead, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Elizabeth_II_and_Laura_Bush.jpg
Photo 4, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Mrs._Laura_Bush_and_daughters_pose_for_a_photo_with_Sesame_Street_character_Elmo.jpg
